تستحثي (form X)
# تَسْتَحِثِّي (tastaḥiṯṯī) /tas.ta.ħiθ.θiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# تُسْتَحَثِّي (tustaḥaṯṯī) /tus.ta.ħaθ.θiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
